entries.text: kneeling, cupping a glowing mushroom like a lantern
mid-stride, cloak snapping in the wind
crouched on a gargoyle, scanning the street below
leaning on a planted greatsword, head bowed
fingers splayed around a tightening coil of light
seated cross-legged, hovering an inch off the ground
drawing a bow to the cheek, one eye shut
mid-song, one boot planted on a tavern table
reading while walking, book held high
tinkering on one knee, tongue between teeth
arms raised, calling down a storm
back to a wall, dagger hidden behind the wrist
charging downhill behind a raised shield
hand outstretched, offering a coin to the viewer
turning mid-step to glance over one shoulder
perched on a crate, whetting a blade
blessing a kneeling stranger
sprawled sideways across a throne, legs over the arm
sprinting across rooftops, coat trailing
wading waist-deep, lantern held overhead
kneeling in snow beside a fallen banner
balancing on a rope bridge, arms flung wide
mid-somersault over a swinging blade
presenting a sealed scroll with a sly bow
hunched over a map by a candle stub
whispering to a raven perched on the forearm
two-handed swing frozen at its peak
praying, brow pressed to a sword hilt
blowing sparks from cupped hands
tossing a vial while already turning away
crouched low, knuckles to the ground
striding out of smoke, weapon dragged behind
standing guard, spear planted, chin high
head thrown back laughing, tankard raised
sitting on a treasure heap, counting coins
stepping out of a portal, one foot still in shadow
floating, eyes rolled white, pages orbiting
